candidates.description: Requester id does not match any known customer id in customers list
candidates.why_not_covered: Coverage summary shows requester_id values only include existing customer ids (C1, C2), but no unknown requester_id tested
candidates.trigger_condition: When requester_id is not one of the customer ids present in customers list
candidates.risk_reason: If agent does not properly verify requester_id against customers list, it might incorrectly authorize refunds without valid requester identity
candidates.scenario_template: Requester uses an unknown id not in customers list
candidates.novelty_claim: No scenario uses a requester_id not in customers; all requester_ids correspond to customers present

candidates.description: Requester is invalid but marked as valid customer
candidates.why_not_covered: No scenario covers invalid requester when customer is marked valid simultaneously
candidates.trigger_condition: When the requester_id corresponds to a customer who is marked valid=false in the customers list but request_claims valid
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might wrongly accept requests from invalid requesters who are incorrectly trusted
candidates.scenario_template: Requester claims to be a valid customer but is invalid
candidates.novelty_claim: Existing coverage has requester_valid as true only when customer is valid; no mismatch scenario

candidates.description: Multiple payments for one customer, multiple refunds requested sequentially
candidates.why_not_covered: Scenarios have multiple payments but not multiple refund requests within same conversation for different payments
candidates.trigger_condition: When multiple refund requests are made for multiple payments of a single customer within the same session
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might mishandle tracking of refund state across multiple payments or requests
candidates.scenario_template: Request refunds for multiple payments sequentially in one session
candidates.novelty_claim: Existing 'request_pattern' dimension covers single or repeat but no coverage on multiple distinct payments refunded sequentially

candidates.description: Refund request on a payment with a currency other than INR or USD
candidates.why_not_covered: Coverage summary observes 'INR' and 'USD' only, no other currencies tested
candidates.trigger_condition: When a payment to be refunded uses a currency not INR or USD
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might mishandle currency assumptions and incorrectly approve/deny or misreport refund amounts
candidates.scenario_template: Refund a payment in a payment currency outside of INR and USD
candidates.novelty_claim: No existing scenario uses any currency other than INR or USD

candidates.description: Customers list with multiple customers where some are valid and some invalid
candidates.why_not_covered: Coverage summary shows customers count of 1 or 2 but does not show scenarios where customers have mixed validities
candidates.trigger_condition: When customers list contains both valid and invalid customers
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might incorrectly verify requester or payment ownership or validity across customers
candidates.scenario_template: Have two customers, one valid and one invalid, and refund payment for either
candidates.novelty_claim: Existing multi-customer scenarios have both valid or both invalid but not mixed validity

candidates.why_not_covered: Tool faults cover get_payment and issue_refund but no faults injected on request_approval
candidates.trigger_condition: When the agent calls request_approval and fault occurs in that call
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might not handle approval call failure properly, causing incorrect refund authorization or repeated requests
candidates.scenario_template: request_approval call fails by timeout or error
candidates.novelty_claim: No existing scenario has request_approval faults

candidates.description: Request refund on a payment already refunded but approval returns approve
candidates.why_not_covered: Existing refunded payments scenarios have approval deny but no scenario where approval approves refund on already refunded payment
candidates.trigger_condition: Refund requested on already refunded payment and approval grants approval
candidates.risk_reason: Agent must not refund twice; wrong handling with approval might cause double refunds
candidates.scenario_template: Request refund on already refunded payment with approval approving
candidates.novelty_claim: Existing refunded payment scenarios only have deny approval or no approval since refunds not needed

candidates.description: Payment amount is just one unit above 50000 requiring approval
candidates.why_not_covered: Coverage summary shows 50000, 60000 but not values just above 50000 like 50001
candidates.trigger_condition: When payment amount is 50001 which is just above approval threshold
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might mistakenly bypass approval or perform faulty comparison logic near threshold
candidates.scenario_template: Refund request for payment amount 50001 requiring approval
candidates.novelty_claim: Existing boundary tests only cover 50000 exactly and 60000 well above threshold

candidates.description: Request pattern with multiple refund requests for same payment within session
candidates.why_not_covered: Coverage covers pattern repeat vs single but no explicit test only for multiple refund requests for same payment and verifies no double refund
candidates.trigger_condition: When user repeats refund request on same payment multiple times
candidates.risk_reason: Agent must not refund payment multiple times; failure to detect repeated attempts is critical
candidates.scenario_template: Multiple refund requests for one payment within one session
candidates.novelty_claim: No explicit scenario tests repeated refund requests for same payment while including multiple repeats and fault responses
